_meta.maintained_by: night shift / Sunday shift workers; verify with Brian when status changes
_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the SuccessBrian OS fleet inventory, demand targets, and storage plan. Read by tools/capacity.py and tools/ecosystem_state.py (never copy the list into code).
_meta.source_key: Every numeric field carries a *_source tag: measured | by_design | plan_target | plan_stated | estimate_unverified. A number without a source tag is a bug — fix it, don't ship it.
_meta.why: capacity.py and ecosystem_state.py each carried their own hard-coded fleet list, which drifted (DeepSeek 150B stayed listed after it was retired 2026-10-02). One registry means one edit when the fleet changes.
